# MCP feature lifecycle and deprecations

Every part of this package's MCP surface is in one of three states, following
the specification's own lifecycle policy (SEP-2596):

| State | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Active** | Supported. Listed here only when its future is a question worth recording. |
| **Deprecated** | Still works, warns once per process, and will be removed no earlier than the date below. |
| **Removed** | Gone. Kept listed so an operator meeting an old config knows what happened. |

A deprecation runs for at least **365 days** between the day it
is announced and the earliest day it may be withdrawn. That window is enforced by
a test, not by good intentions.

The source of truth is `FEATURE_STATES` in
[`personas/sakthai/mcp/lifecycle.py`](../personas/sakthai/mcp/lifecycle.py).
This file is generated from it; edit the registry, then run
`python scripts/gen_mcp_deprecations.py`.


## Deprecated

### `transport: "sse"`

The `"sse"` value for an MCP server's `type`/`transport` key in `mcp.json`.

It never named an SSE transport. `RemoteMCPClient` POSTs JSON-RPC and accepts either a JSON or an SSE-framed reply — that is Streamable HTTP. There is no GET stream, which is what an SSE transport would be. Every remote entry in the six shipped persona manifests omits `type` entirely and so was labelled `"sse"` by default, making the misnomer universal and invisible. Keeping the name would leave operators configuring a transport that does not exist. The HTTP+SSE transport itself is separately deprecated upstream, in spec revision 2026-07-28 (SEP-2596).

| | |
|---|---|
| Use instead | `transport: "streamable-http"` |
| Deprecated since | 2026-11-23 |
| Removal not before | 2027-11-23 |
| Notice given | 365 days |

### `_meta["ui/resourceUri"]`

The flat spelling of the MCP Apps tool-to-UI link.

The MCP Apps extension (SEP-1865) carries both a nested `_meta.ui.resourceUri` and this flat form, and states the flat one will be removed before the extension reaches GA. This package emits the nested form; the entry exists so that a host still reading the flat key is not surprised by its absence.

| | |
|---|---|
| Use instead | `_meta.ui.resourceUri` |
| Deprecated since | 2026-11-23 |
| Removal not before | 2027-11-23 |
| Notice given | 365 days |


## Active, with a note

### `protocol: 2024-11-05`

The first MCP protocol revision, still accepted by the server.

Four revisions behind, but hosts do pin it and negotiation makes supporting it nearly free. Kept Active deliberately: there is no plan to drop it, and listing it here is so that intent is on the record rather than inferred from the version table.

| | |
|---|---|
| Use instead | `protocol: 2025-11-25` |

### `SAKTHAI_MCP_ENV_PASSTHROUGH=all`

Hands a spawned MCP server the entire parent environment instead of the 14-name allowlist.

An escape hatch for a server that needs a variable the allowlist omits, and it hands over every API key the process holds. Active because there is no finer-grained alternative yet; a spec `env` block is the targeted replacement and already works per-server.

| | |
|---|---|
| Use instead | `a per-server env block in mcp.json` |
